main_measure.name: mean unusual 1-day move after a long bet (close to next close minus coin's mean daily return)

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day taken together

main_measure.threshold: positive with t >= 2 over at least 30 distinct case days to confirm; negative with t <= -2 to reject

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move of deeper half minus shallower half (split at median post_pipeline_value of depth_below_low)

decided_by: t >= 2 but the deeper half does not beat the shallower half, which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Bets are taken on every bar (1-bar grid) as long rises of the forecast of >= 2 points from its lowest long level since the last bet; the regime part of the situation is read from the recorded `regime` column; the day-clustered t uses per-day summed deviations with a G/(G-1) correction; the deeper half is the cases strictly above the median depth and the shallower half those at or below it; a count below 30 days is reported as not observable.
